question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Mr. Stein is a very __cold__ and hard man.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cold"** means lacking affection or warmth of feeling; unemotional. (ठंडा, भावहीन)

 
 
• **Example:** His** cold **demeanor made it difficult for others to approach him.
 
 
 
• **Clement (कृपालु): **Mild or merciful in disposition or character; lenient.
 
 
• Example: The judge was **clement **in his sentencing.​
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cold' is 'clement’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Relaxed** (आरामदायक): Free from tension and anxiety; at ease.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt **relaxed **after the long vacation.
 
 
 
• **Tolerant** (सहनशील): Showing willingness to allow the existence of opinions or behavior that one does not necessarily agree with.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very **tolerant **of different cultures and beliefs.
 
 
 
• **"Charitable"** refers to showing kindness and generosity towards others, especially in giving help to those in need. (दयालु, परोपकारी)
 
 
• Example: She is known for her** charitable **nature, always willing to help those in need.
